article.title: Play Date: Make Room for Movement
article.body:
Some days call for a little movement and a little color. The Play Date Ruched Sports Bra & Shorts Set belongs in that part of your Miss.Princess edit: the walk you have been meaning to take, the class in your calendar, or a moment to move at your own pace.

Let the details lead

The set pairs a sports bra with shorts and ruched detailing. Before choosing, explore the current product photos and options. The product page is the place to compare measurements and see what is available for your own edit.

Choose your own way to wear it

Keep the pair together for a coordinated look, or make room for a layer from your wardrobe when your plans change. Color can set the mood; the listed sizing details help you make the practical choice.

Compare the measurements with a piece you already enjoy wearing. If you are deciding between options or need a detail that is not shown, customer care can help you take a closer look.

Before it joins your bag

Check the current delivery estimate and care information on the product page. Review the shipping and return policies, then choose the option that belongs in your plans.

article.title: Choosing a Necklace for Your Everyday Edit
article.body:
A necklace can give a familiar outfit a new point of view. Begin with the pieces you already wear, the necklines you return to, and the details that feel like your own. The MVQUEEN jewelry edit is a place to explore that finishing note.

Start with the neckline

Picture the piece with a favorite shirt, knit or dress. Consider where you would like the necklace to sit and whether you want a single detail or a layered look. Compare the listed length with a necklace you already know well.

A photograph gives you a sense of the piece. The listed measurements help you understand its scale. Look at both before making your choice.

Take a closer look at the finish

Read the material and finish listed on the product page. Explore the available photos and options, and check any care guidance provided for the piece. If a detail matters to your choice and is not shown, ask customer care before ordering.

Make the detail your own

Let your existing wardrobe guide the choice. A piece you can picture with several familiar looks has room to become part of your everyday edit. You decide how much of a statement it makes.

Collections change over time. Visit the current necklace and jewelry edits for the pieces available now, along with their latest details and delivery estimates.

page.body:
Frequently Asked Questions

What is the difference between MVQUEEN and Miss.Princess?

MVQUEEN is the refined, neutral, bold side of the house. Miss.Princess is the softer, brighter, more playful sister world. Both are part of the same store and share one bag, checkout, and customer-care experience.

Can I shop both brands in one order?

Yes. You can add MVQUEEN and Miss.Princess products to the same bag and complete one checkout.

How long does shipping take?

Most orders are estimated to arrive within 7–15 business days after shipment. Processing time varies by product and supplier. Some products may have shorter delivery estimates such as 5–7 or 6–10 business days. Check the product page and Shipping Policy for the most relevant estimate.

Where do products ship from?

MVQUEEN curates products from multiple supply and fulfillment sources. Some products may be stored or shipped by third-party fulfillment partners, so items in the same order can arrive in separate packages. MVQUEEN remains your customer-service contact for orders placed through this store.

Can I change my order?

Contact miss.mvqueen@gmail.com as soon as possible. Changes cannot be guaranteed after fulfillment begins.

How do returns work?

Review our Refund & Returns Policy for eligibility, timing, return shipping, and instructions. Contact us before mailing a return so we can provide the correct instructions for your order.

Where can I find product details?

Product pages may include material, color, measurements, ingredients, care guidance, usage information, shipping estimates, and other product-specific details when available.

How can I contact customer care?

Use the Contact page, email miss.mvqueen@gmail.com, or call +1 864-871-8732 for order, product, shipping, return, or general support.
